description: A very extensive network of single track trails of all skill ratings, leading down through the River Valley and into town. **** The Spokey Hollow Trail Network is within an active Cattle Range, please consider riding without your dogs. If you need to take your dog with you, please consider the Fox Mtn trails*****
directions:
The main access point to the top of the network is; from Hwy 20 West, turn right onto Esler Road, past the soccer complex is Bysak Road (under the powerlines), follow this main road for approximately 4km and on the right is the trail head for Snakes and Ladders Trail, from Snakes you can branch out onto many of the other lines.
The network terminates in the Williams Lake River Valley and main parking area is across from the cemetery on Mackenzie Ave.
title: Spokey Hollow Trail
